hypothesis: Strategy B breakouts below their own 200-day moving average are more often recovery bounces than continuation breakouts; requiring above_200ma may improve breakout follow-through without changing exits, sizing, or ranking.

production_impact.promotion_requirement: If accepted, update shared quant/signal_engine.py only; both backtester.py and run.py already call generate_signals from that module.

rejection_reason: Hard above_200ma breakout gating dropped zero candidates in all three fixed windows and is therefore not promoted.
